caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, brownish-red metallic bucket or pot-like object suspended from three interlocking, oval-shaped metal rings at the top. The object has a hammered texture with visible spots and variations in color that range from reddish-brown to coppery tones with hints of green patina. The upper rim features a scalloped or petal-like edge, while the lower section is decorated with a row of rounded, bulbous segments that encircle it. The object is centered on a plain, off-white background with no additional items or decorations visible. The artist's signature, "DANA BARTLETT," is located in the bottom right corner.
title: Copper Bucket
